responsibility: Defines the core target macros, ABI constants, register file description, storage layout, assembler syntax, and per-function machine data for the TILE-Gx port. It establishes endianness handling, scalar type sizes, alignment rules, hard-register numbers and classes, register names, PIC/TLS special registers, argument and stack-related conventions, assembler output helpers, and target-specific configuration macros consumed by both generic GCC code and tilegx.c.
same_name_distinction: Provides the TILE-Gx port’s header-level ABI, register, layout, and assembler macros shared with the compiler, unlike tilegx.c which implements hook behavior in C, tilegx.md which describes RTL instruction patterns, and tilegx.opt which defines user-visible -m target options and generated option variables.
